FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 606
Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Sponsor: Representative Chris Blackshear
Infrastructure
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/29/2025
House Bill 606 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of
Transportation (ALDOT) paid from the Public Road and Bridge Fund by an undetermined
amount dependent on the costs of relocating certain utility facilities, which are owned by
utilities with $250 million or less in gross annual income, due to non-interstate highway
projects.
This bill would also prohibit ALDOT from assessing fees for the use or placement of utilities on
any state right-of-way. Per ALDOT, no such fees are currently assessed.
